physics-e2-q2.prompt: Xa abantu bethetha nge-'foni yentambo' eyenziwe ngeekomityi zamaphepha amabini nentambo yesilika, yeyiphi indlela eyenza ixesha lokuva ilizwi lomnye ngokucacileyo?

physics-e2-q3.prompt: Beka iinkozo zerayisi ezininzi phezu kwedrama enkulu uze ubethe idrama ngentonga ngobuthathaka nangamandla. Ngowuphi umbono ochanekileyo ngoqhathaniso?

physics-e2-q4.prompt: Xa kubekwe ikhandlela elivuthayo phambi kwesipikha edlala umculo ngokuvuthuza, ilangatye lekhandlela lanyikima ngokweemvakalelo zomculo. Kungani oku kwenzeke?

physics-e2-q4.explanation: Ilaphu lesipikha liyanyikima lenze umoya unyikime, kwaye ukunyikima komoya (amaza esandi) kuhanjiswa kwilangatye lekhandlela ukuze linyikime.

physics-e2-c.prompt: [Ingqiqo eqhubekekayo] Ioli yewotshi ye-alamu ibekwe ngaphakathi kwebhel yeglasi engenamoya, kwaye i-alamu ilayishiwe. Isandla sewotshi siyanyikima sibetha ibhelu, kodwa asikho isandi esivakalayo. Kungani?

physics-e2-q5.prompt: Xa kubethwa i-xylophone okanye iinqaku zayo, loluphi uqhathaniso oluchanekileyo lobude nobukhulu besandi seenqaku ezifutshane nezinde?

physics-e3-q1.prompt: Xa kubekwe amaphepha amathathu anemingxuma ecaleni komnye phambi kwetorshi, ungawubeka njani imingxuma ukuze ubone ukukhanya kwelinye icala?

options.a: Beka imingxuma emithathu kumgca othe nkqo

physics-e3-q2.prompt: Sifuna ukwenza isithunzi sebhere yokudlala sibe sikhulu ngaphezu kwangoku kwiscreen. Yeyiphi indlela efanelekileyo?
hints: Xa into isondele kwindawo ekhanyayo, indawo ekuvalayo ukukhanya iyanda.

physics-e3-q2.explanation: Xa umgama phakathi komthombo wokukhanya (itorshi) nento ulinciphisa, ikona into evala ukukhanya iyakhula, ngoko isithunzi esenziwa kwiscreen siyakhula.

physics-e3-q3.prompt: Itorshi ikhanyiswe kwizinto ezintathu (iglasi ecacileyo, iphepha elinamafutha, iphepha elimnyama elityebileyo) kwaye kubonwe izithunzi kudonga. Yeyiphi into eyenza isithunzi esimnyama nesicacileyo kakhulu?
hints: Khangela into engagqitheli kukukhanya (opaque).
Iglasi yenza ukukhanya kuwele kakhulu, ngoko isithunzi sibambene.
physics-e3-q3.explanation: Iphepha elimnyama elityebileyo yinto engagqitheli kukukhanya, ngoko ukukhanya kuyavalwa ngokupheleleyo kwaye kwenziwa isithunzi esimnyama kakhulu.

physics-e3-q4.prompt: Kwimini ecacileyo, kubonwe isithunzi sepali yebhanile ekwiindlala, kwaye ekuseni nasebusuku isithunzi side kakhulu, ngentsimbi ye-12 emini sisifutshane kakhulu. Kungani?

options.b: Kuba ngemini isantya sokukhanya kwelanga siyakhawuleza
options.c: Kuba ekuseni ubude bepali yebhanile buyanda

Ukuphakama kwelanga kuphezulu, isithunzi sifutshane.
physics-e3-q4.explanation: Ukuphakama kwelanga kuphezulu, ukukhanya kuwela phantsi ngokuthe nkqo isithunzi sifutshane, kwaye ekuseni nasemva kwemini ukuphakama kwelanga kuphantsi, ukukhanya kuwela ngokuthe gruzu, ngoko isithunzi side.

physics-e3-c.prompt: [Uphando oluqhubekekayo] Umngxuma omncinane wenziwa ngaphambili kwebhokisi kwaye iphepha eliyi-translucent libekwe emva ukwenza 'ikhamera yomngxuma omncinane', kwaye xa kubonwa ikhandlela, umfanekiso wekhandlela wenziwa ujike phezulu-nezantsi nasekhohlo-nasekunene. options.a: Kuba ukukhanya okuvela phezulu nasezantsi kwekhandlela kuhamba ngokuthe ngqo kuwele umngxuma
options.b: Kuba ukukhanya kubonakala kugobe ngaphakathi komngxuma

physics-e3-c.explanation: Ukukhanya okuvela kwinxalenye ephezulu yento kuhamba ngokuthe ngqo kuwele umngxuma kufike kwinxalenye esezantsi yephepha elitranslucent, kwaye ukukhanya kwinxalenye esezantsi kufika phezulu, ngoko umfanekiso wenziwa ujike.

physics-e3-q5.prompt: Kwigumbi elimnyama, xa ukukhanya kwetorshi kuthotyelwe kwisipili esibhityileyo esiqhelekileyo, yintoni eyenzeka kukukhanya?

options.d: Ukukhanya kwahlulwa kwiindlela ezininzi kube yi-rainbow

Ikona yokungena ilingana nekona yokubuyisela.
physics-e3-q5.explanation: Xa ukukhanya kuhamba ngokuthe ngqo kudibana nomphezulu obhityileyo onjengesipili, kutshintsha indlela kubuye kubuyele ngasemva, kwaye oku kubizwa ngokuthi 'ukubuyisela kokukhanya'.

physics-e4-q1.prompt: Kwisikali esinengalo ezimbini, kulengiswe ubunzima obuyi-20 g kwindawo ekude ngezahlulo ezi-4 ukusuka kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa ngasekhohlo. Ubunzima bokulengiswa kwindawo ekude ngezahlulo ezi-2 ukusuka kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa ngasekunene ukuze kulingane yintoni?
hints: Bala (umgama wasekhohlo × ubunzima) = (umgama wasekunene × ubunzima).
Ekhohlo 4 × 20 = 80, ngoko ekunene kufuneka 2 × (?) = 80.
physics-e4-q1.explanation: Ngokomgaqo wokulinganisa, umzuzwana wasekhohlo ($4\text{ isahlulo} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) nomzuzwana wasekunene ($2\text{ isahlulo} \times ? = 80$) kufuneka belingane, ngoko kufuneka kulengiswe ubunzima $40\text{ g}$.

physics-e4-q2.prompt: Xa umntakwenu omkhulu onobunzima obuyi-40 kg nomntakwenu omncinane onobunzima obuyi-20 kg bedlala kwi-see-saw, kufuneka behlale njani ukuze balingane bonwabe?

options.a: Omkhulu ahlale esondele kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa kunomncinane
options.b: Omkhulu ahlale ekude kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa kunomncinane
options.d: Omkhulu nomncinane bahlale kunye kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa

hints: Icala elinzima lehla ezantsi.
Umgama wecala elinzima kufuneka unciphe ukuze isiphumo (ubunzima × umgama) silingane.
physics-e4-q2.explanation: Umntakwenu omkhulu onobunzima ($40\text{ kg}$) kufuneka asondele kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa ngesiqingatha somgama womntakwenu omncinane onobunzima ($20\text{ kg}$) ukuze bahlale belingene.

physics-e4-q3.prompt: Kuvavanyo lokulinganisa, kulengiswe iibhloko ezi-2 ze-10 g kwizahlulo ezi-3 ngasekhohlo kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa. Zingaphi iibhloko ze-10 g ezifunekayo kwisahlulo esi-1 ngasekunene ukuze kulingane?
hints: Ubunzima obupheleleyo bekhohlo yi-20 g nomgama zizahlulo ezi-3 (3 × 20 = 60).
Kuba umgama wasekunene sisahlulo esi-1, ubunzima kufuneka bube yi-60 g (iibhloko ezi-6).
physics-e4-q3.explanation: Isiphumo samandla asekhohlo $3 \times 20\text{ g} = 60$. Kuba umgama wasekunene $1\text{ isahlulo}$, ubunzima obufunekayo $60\text{ g}$, kwaye kufuneka iibhloko ze-$10\text{ g}$ $6$.

physics-e4-q4.prompt: Xa kukhutshwa isikhonkwane esiqinileyo ebhodini leplanga ngesando sokukhupha izikhonkwane, kutheni kufuneka amandla amancinci xa ubambe ekupheleni kwesibambo kunokuba ubambe embindini, yintoni isizathu sesayensi?

options.a: Kuba umgama ukusuka kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa (inxalenye egobileyo yentloko yesando) ukuya kwiphoyinti yamandla (isibambo) wande
options.b: Kuba ubunzima besikhonkwane buye bakhaphukhaphu ngequbuliso
options.d: Kuba ibhodi leplanga linyibilika libe bugciwane

hints: Cinga ngomgaqo wekhefu.
Xa umgama phakathi kwephoyinti yokuxhasa nephoyinti yamandla mkhulu, amandla amancinci anokuvelisa amandla amakhulu.
physics-e4-q4.explanation: Ekhefini, xa umgama phakathi kwephoyinti yokuxhasa nephoyinti yamandla mde, amandla amancinci anokudlulisela amandla amakhulu kwindawo yokusebenza, ngoko kulula ukukhupha isikhonkwane.

physics-e4-c.prompt: Xa uthatha ikhefu lokuphakamisa idwala elinzima, ukuba uyibeka iphoyinti yokuxhasa ngaphambili kwedwala (indawo yokusebenza), amandla owafaka ngesandla ayancipha, kodwa umgama owuhambayo isandla utshintsha njani?

options.a: Umgama ekufuneka usuke ngawo isandla uyanda
options.b: Umgama ekufuneka usuke ngawo isandla uyancipha nawo

hints: Xa usebenzisa ikhefu ufumana inzuzo emandleni, uphulukana emgameni.
Oku kubizwa ngokuba ngumgaqo womsebenzi kwifiziksi.
physics-e4-c.explanation: Ngokusebenzisa ikhefu amandla anganciphisa, kodwa umgama ekufuneka usuke ngawo isandla uyanda ngokuyilingana, ngoko isixa sakho somsebenzi siyagcinwa (umgaqo womsebenzi).

physics-e4-q5.prompt: Kutheni kusenziwa lula ukuhambisa umthwalo onzima ngokuwubeka kwisithuthuthu esinamavili nokuwutyhala kunokuwurhuqa phantsi?

options.a: Kuba xa ivili lijikeleza, 'amandla okungqubana kokujikeleza' aba mancinane kunamandla okungqubana kokushiyela
options.b: Kuba iivili zinciphisa ubunzima bomthwalo ukuya ku-1/10

physics-e4-q5.explanation: Xa kusetyenziswa iivili, ukungqubana kokushiyela phakathi komhlaba nento kuguqulwa kube kokungqubana kokujikeleza okuncinci kakhulu, ngoko amandla okungqubana ayasichasa ukushukuma ancipha kakhulu.

physics-e5-q1.prompt: Yeyiphi inkcazo yesayensi echanekileyo yokuqhathanisa isantya (ukukhawuleza) kwento?

options.a: Xa kuhanjwa umgama ofanayo, ixesha elifutshane liyakwenza isantya sibe siphezulu
options.b: Xa kuhanjwa ngexesha elifanayo, umgama omfutshane wenza isantya siphezulu
options.d: Ukuba into inzima ngakumbi, isantya sihlala sinjalo

hints: Kwimpikiswano yokugijima, umdlali wokuqala usebenzisa ixesha elifutshane ukuya kumgca wokugqibela.
Isantya = umgama ÷ ixesha
physics-e5-q1.explanation: Xa kuhanjwa umgama ofanayo, xa ixesha lifutshane, kwenziwa ngokukhawuleza, kwaye xa kuhanjwa ngexesha elifanayo, xa umgama mde, isantya siphezulu.

physics-e5-q2.prompt: Xa kuyilwa uvavanyo ukuqhathanisa ngokufanelekileyo isantya sebhola yentsimbi eqengqeleka phantsi kwiindawo ezithe nkqo ezahlukeneyo, yintoni engeyondlela 'yemeko ekufuneka igcinwe ifana (iyantlukwano elawulwayo)'?

options.b: Ukuphakama (indawo) apho ibhola yentsimbi iqala ukuqengqeleka

hints: Khangela imeko esifuna ukuyitshintsha (iyantlukwano ezimeleyo).
Ukuze kubonwe isantya ngokwekona, ikona kufuneka ibe yahlukile.
physics-e5-q2.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba sifuna ukwazi isantya ngokwekona yeplani, ikona yeplani yiyantlukwano 'ephathwayo' ekufuneka itshintshwe, kwaye ezinye iimeko kufuneka zilawulwe zifane.

physics-e5-q3.prompt: Kukhuphiswano lokugijima lwe-100 m, iirekhodi zabadlali abane zezi. Ngubani onesantya esikhawulezayo kakhulu? (Seonu: imizuzwana eyi-14, Minji: eyi-16, Haeun: eyi-15, Jiho: eyi-18)
hints: Khangela umdlali osebenzise ixesha elincinci xa kugijimwa umgama ofanayo we-100 m.
Imizuzwana eyi-14 lixesha elifutshane kakhulu.
physics-e5-q3.explanation: Kuba umgama $100\text{ m}$ ufanayo, uSeonu osebenzise ixesha elifutshane kakhulu (imizuzwana $14$) unesantya esiphakathi $7.14\text{ m/s}$ esikhawulezayo kakhulu.

physics-e5-q4.prompt: Imoto idlule kwindawo yolawulo lwesantya kwindlela enkulu (umgama opheleleyo we-30 km) ngemizuzu eyi-15. Sisantya esiphakathi sale moto singakanani ngeekhilomitha ngeyure?
hints: Guqula imizuzu eyi-15 ibe ngamayunithi eeyure.
Imizuzu eyi-15 = 15/60 iiyure = 0.25 iiyure (1/4 yeyure).
physics-e5-q4.explanation: Imizuzu $15$ yiyure $\frac{15}{60} = 0.25$ ($\frac{1}{4}$ iyure). Isantya esiphakathi $30\text{ km} \div 0.25\text{ h} = 120\text{ km/h}$.

physics-e5-c.prompt: [Ukutolika idatha eqhubekekayo] Kwigrafu yomgama ngokwexesha, yeyiphi i-quantity yefiziksi emelwe 'sisithuba' somgca wegrafu, nemeko yokushukuma kwento xa umgca othe ngqo unesithuba esingatshintshiyo, ibhanyana elichanekileyo kukuphi?
hints: Kwigrafu, (utshintsho lwe-axis ethe nkqo ÷ utshintsho lwe-axis ethe tye) = (umgama ÷ ixesha).
Umgama ÷ ixesha sisantya.
physics-e5-c.explanation: Isithuba segrafu yexesha-umgama (umgama ÷ ixesha) simela 'isantya', kwaye umgca othe ngqo onesithuba esingatshintshiyo ubonisa 'ukushukuma okufanayo' okunesantya esingatshintshiyo.

physics-e5-q5.prompt: Xa kuhanjwa umgama ofanayo we-60 km, bubuphi ububanzi besiphumo sexesha phakathi kwemoto egijima ngesantya se-60 km ngeyure nebhasi egijima ngesantya se-30 km ngeyure?

options.a: Ibhasi ithatha iyure eli-1 ngaphezu kwemoto
options.b: Imoto ithatha iiyure ezi-2 ngaphezu kwebhasi
options.c: Iimoto zombini zithatha ixesha elifanayo ncam
options.d: Ibhasi ithatha imizuzu eyi-30 ngaphezu kwemoto

hints: Sebenzisa ifomula ixesha = umgama ÷ isantya.
Imoto: 60/60 = iyure eli-1, ibhasi: 60/30 = iiyure ezi-2
physics-e5-q5.explanation: Imoto ithatha $60\text{ km} \div 60\text{ km/h} = 1$ iyure kwaye ibhasi ithatha $60\text{ km} \div 30\text{ km/h} = 2$ iiyure, ngoko ibhasi ithatha iyure $1$ ngaphezulu.

physics-e6-q1.prompt: Umntu ufuna ukukhanyisa isibane ngebhetri e-1, izibane ezi-2 kunye nesiphakamisi ngocingo. Yeyiphi imeko echanekileyo 'yesekethe evaliweyo' ekhanyisa isibane?

options.a: Kufuneka kudityaniswe ngaphandle kokuqhawuka ukusuka kwipali (+) yebhetri ngesiphakamisi nesibane ukuya kwipali (-)
options.b: Kufuneka iziphelo zombini zocingo zidityaniswe kwipali (+) yebhetri kuphela
options.c: Kufuneka kufakwe irabha kumbindi wocingo ukuqokelela umbane

$\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4\cdot3}{2}=6$, $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2$.
physics-killer-11.explanation: Kuba $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$, $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ ayixhomekekanga kwisantya, ngoko $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ukuba umlinganiselo wentlawulo uyalityalwa, $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba kucingelwa ukuba ixesha lilingana nesantya, $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (impendulo engalunganga ③), ukuba kuhoywa umlinganiselo wobunzima nowentlawulo kwaye kusetyenziswa umlinganiselo wesantya kuphela, $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (impendulo engalunganga ④).

physics-killer-12.prompt: Phezu komgangatho othe tye kubekwe iirelsi ezimbini ezifanayo zesikhokelisi ezinomgama $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, kwaye esinye isiphelo siqhagamshelwe kumelana. Ukumelana okupheleleyo kwesekethe evaliweyo eyakhiwe ngerelsi, umthi wesikhokelisi nokumelana $2\,\Omega$. Umbane omagnethi ohambelana othe nkqo $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ usebenza kuyo yonke isekethe, kwaye umthi wesikhokelisi uhamba phezu kwerelsi ngesantya esingatshintshiyo $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kude nokumelana. Ngexesha apho umthi uhamba $2\,\mathrm{m}$ ngexesha $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$, i-magnetic flux ehamba kwisekethe itshintsha nge-$\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani bomsinga obangelwayo kwisekethe kunye nobungakanani bamandla angaphandle afunekayo ukugcina umthi usesantyeni esingatshintshiyo ngokulandelelana? hints: Umthetho ka-Faraday $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=B\ell v$, $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}$. Ukuba intshukumo ayitshintshi, amandla angaphandle alingana namandla emagnethi kwaye $F=BI\ell$.
$\Delta\Phi=0.5\times0.5\times2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $\mathcal E=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$.
physics-killer-12.explanation: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ (iyahambelana ne-$=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Amandla emagnethi asebenza kumthi ngu-$F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (ngokomthetho ka-Lenz ngecala elithintela intshukumo) kwaye kuba intshukumo ayitshintshi, namandla angaphandle ngu-$0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Ukuqinisekisa: amandla amandla angaphandle $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Ukuba $\ell$ iyalityalwa, $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba $\ell$ ilityalwa kumandla, $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (impendulo engalunganga ②), impazamo yokuphinda-phinda $\mathcal E$ ngo-$\frac12$ ngumphendulo ongalunganga ④.
